name: Can I install a new roof over my old one?

mainEntity.name: Can I install a new roof over my old one?

acceptedAnswer.text: In some cases, a new layer of shingles can be installed over an existing layer, but it's generally not recommended. This is known as a 're-roof.' While it can be a less expensive option initially, it adds significant weight to your roof structure, can mask underlying issues like rotting decking, and may void manufacturer warranties. Most building codes allow a maximum of two layers. A complete tear-off and replacement is almost always the better long-term solution, ensuring a solid foundation and proper inspection of the roof deck.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing a new roof over an old one (re-roofing) is sometimes possible but generally not recommended due to added weight, potential hidden damage, and warranty issues. A full tear-off is usually better.
